$description: The look of the README pictures drawn by draw.py, as design tokens (W3C Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10). Tokens only: no labels, no layout. draw.py reads each $value; the ER pipeline reads the same file for its mermaid theme.

ink.$description: text, lines, arrows, arrowheads, a solid frame

muted.$description: captions, edge labels, a dashed frame's label

dash.$description: a dashed frame with no meaning colour

fill.$description: a box with no meaning colour

background.$description: the sheet; opaque, so on GitHub dark each picture is its own white card

key.$description: One colour per meaning, the same meaning in every picture. border: a box's edge and a frame's outline; tint: a box's fill; label: a frame's label, clearing 4.5:1 on white.

public.$description: public open data and its reference copy

product.$description: the product: what members use and see

stored.$description: the database, its ledger and what is stored

alert.$description: alerts and models: a pale yellow told from vermilion by lightness and a heavier near-black border, since a darker amber looked the same as vermilion to protan and deutan readers

familyCJK.$description: added before the generic family on the sheet, and inlined by --png; without it 中央氣象署 rasterises as empty boxes

size.$description: In drawing units on the size.canvas sheet. Minimums, not free choices: at the README's rendered width each must stay at or above size.minimumRendered.

title.$description: a box title, a note heading

body.$description: captions, edge labels, frame labels, notes

small.$description: the architecture picture's two lines beside the Ollama mark; at 838 px it renders at 11.97, a hair under size.minimumRendered, kept because today's pictures are kept byte for byte

canvas.$description: the sheet's width: GitHub's README column is 838 px, so one unit renders at about one pixel

minimumRendered.$description: the floor for any text at the README's 838 px rendered width

alert.$description: the heavy border of a color.key.alert box
